title: A Sand and Dust Storm Is Coming
synopsis: Sand and dust storms are a common weather disaster in northern China.

fullText.simplified:
沙尘暴来啦

    沙尘暴是沙暴和尘暴的总称，是指强风从地面卷起大量沙尘，使空气浑浊，水平能见度小于1千米的天气现象。
    沙尘暴天气主要发生在冬春季节。这是由于冬春季半干旱和干旱区降水甚少，地表极其干燥松散，抗风蚀能力很弱。当有大风刮过时，就会有大量沙尘被卷入空中，形成沙尘暴天气。
    2023年4月，与“沙尘暴”有关的多个话题登上热搜榜，一场大范围的沙尘天气正在影响着中国多个地区。
    往年同期的沙尘次数大约是5至6次左右，2023年沙尘出现的次数偏多。为什么2023年中国的沙尘天气频繁来袭呢？
    主要原因有两个：一是2023年1月到3月，中国气温普遍偏高，加上整个北方地区降水偏少，裸露的地表面积较大，沙尘源充足；二是2023年的冷暖空气活动也较频繁，北方地区大风天气增多，有利于沙尘输送。
    沙尘天气会造成空气质量下降，严重影响人们日常生活，对生态环境也会造成一定影响。一旦出现沙尘天气，人们要如何防护呢？
    首先要补充水分，多喝水、果汁、汤类等，加快新陈代谢；其次要保持湿度，室内要打开加湿器，增加湿度；第三要做好遮挡，出门要带好口罩、防风镜等防尘用品，回家后要清洗面部和鼻腔；最后，开车减速，停车远离广告牌，围墙等。
    防沙治标不治本，治沙才是关键。植树造林，保护草场，因地制宜，在沙漠地区种植适合生长的植物，以便固定土壤，降低风速等等，都是治沙的办法。希望未来的日子里，沙尘天气离我们越来越远！
fullText.traditional:
沙塵暴來啦

    沙塵暴是沙暴和塵暴的總稱，是指強風從地面捲起大量沙塵，使空氣渾濁，水平能見度小於1千米的天氣現象。
    沙塵暴天氣主要發生在冬春季節。這是由於冬春季半乾旱和乾旱區降水甚少，地表極其乾燥鬆散，抗風蝕能力很弱。當有大風颳過時，就會有大量沙塵被捲入空中，形成沙塵暴天氣。
    2023年4月，與“沙塵暴”有關的多個話題登上熱搜榜，一場大範圍的沙塵天氣正在影響著中國多個地區。
    往年同期的沙塵次數大約是5至6次左右，2023年沙塵出現的次數偏多。為什麼2023年中國的沙塵天氣頻繁來襲呢？
    主要原因有兩個：一是2023年1月到3月，中國氣溫普遍偏高，加上整個北方地區降水偏少，裸露的地表面積較大，沙塵源充足；二是2023年的冷暖空氣活動也較頻繁，北方地區大風天氣增多，有利於沙塵輸送。
    沙塵天氣會造成空氣質量下降，嚴重影響人們日常生活，對生態環境也會造成一定影響。一旦出現沙塵天氣，人們要如何防護呢？
    首先要補充水分，多喝水、果汁、湯類等，加快新陳代謝；其次要保持濕度，室內要打開加濕器，增加濕度；第三要做好遮擋，出門要帶好口罩、防風鏡等防塵用品，回家後要清洗面部和鼻腔；最後，開車減速，停車遠離廣告牌，圍牆等。
    防沙治標不治本，治沙才是關鍵。植樹造林，保護草場，因地制宜，在沙漠地區種植適合生長的植物，以便固定土壤，降低風速等等，都是治沙的辦法。希望未來的日子裡，沙塵天氣離我們越來越遠！

When strong winds blow over, large amounts of sand and dust will be swept into the air, forming sand and dust storm weather.

Why has sand and dust storm weather hit China frequently in 2023?

sentences.english: .. leading to a larger area of exposed ground surface, providing ample sources of sand and dust.

sentences.traditional: 北方地區大風天氣增多，有利於沙塵輸送。

.. and windy weather in the northern region increased, which was conducive to transporting sand and dust.

sentences.pinyin: yí dàn chū xiàn shā chén tiān qì rén men yào rú hé fáng hù ne

Once a sand and dust storm occurs, how should people protect themselves?

sentences.simplified: 首先要补充水分，多喝水、果汁、汤类等，加快新陈代谢；
sentences.traditional: 首先要補充水分，多喝水、果汁、湯類等，加快新陳代謝；

sentences.simplified: 其次要保持湿度，室内要打开加湿器，增加湿度；
sentences.traditional: 其次要保持濕度，室內要打開加濕器，增加濕度；

sentences.simplified: 第三要做好遮挡，出门要带好口罩、防风镜等防尘用品，
sentences.traditional: 第三要做好遮擋，出門要帶好口罩、防風鏡等防塵用品，
sentences.pinyin: dì sān yào zuò hǎo zhē dǎng chū mén yào dài hǎo kǒu zhào fáng fēng jìng děng fáng chén yòng pǐn

sentences.simplified: 回家后要清洗面部和鼻腔；
sentences.traditional: 回家後要清洗面部和鼻腔；
sentences.pinyin: huí jiā hòu yào qīng xǐ miàn bù hé bí qiāng

sentences.english: After returning home, make sure to clean your face and nasal passages.
Finally, when driving, reduce your speed and park away from billboards, walls, etc.

sentences.traditional: 防沙治標不治本，治沙才是關鍵。
sentences.pinyin: fáng shā zhì biāo bú zhì běn zhì shā cái shì guān jiàn

sentences.traditional: 植樹造林，保護草場，
sentences.pinyin: zhí shù zào lín bǎo hù cǎo chǎng
sentences.english: Protecting against the sand treats the symptoms but not the root cause. Controlling the sand is the key.

sentences.traditional: 因地制宜，在沙漠地區種植適合生長的植物，

sentences.traditional: 以便固定土壤，降低風速等等，都是治沙的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ biàn gù dìng tǔ rǎng jiàng dī fēng sù děng děng dōu shì zhì shā de bàn fǎ
sentences.english: .. and tailoring solutions to local conditions by planting vegetation suitable for growth in desert areas, ..

sentences.traditional: 希望未來的日子裡，沙塵天氣離我們越來越遠！

sentences.english: .. in order to stabilize the soil, reduce wind speed, and so on, are all methods for controlling the sand.

sentence_translations: A Sand and Dust Storm Is Coming
A sand and dust storm is an umbrella term for a sandstorm and dust storm.
It refers to the weather phenomenon where strong winds lift a large amount of sand and dust from the ground, ..
.. making the air dirty and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 1,000 meters.
Sand and dust storm weather mainly occurs in the spring and winter seasons.
This is because, during the winter and spring, there is very little precipitation in semi-arid and arid areas.
The ground is extremely dry and loose, and its ability to resist wind erosion is very weak.
When strong winds blow over, large amounts of sand and dust will be swept into the air, forming sand and dust storm weather.
In April 2023, several topics relating to “sand and dust storms” made the hot searches list.
A large-scale sand and dust storm was affecting many areas of China at the time.
The number of sand and dust storms during the same period in previous years was around five or six.
The frequency of sand and dust storms has been relatively high in 2023.
Why has sand and dust storm weather hit China frequently in 2023?
There are two main reasons: The first is that between January and March 2023, the temperature in China was generally higher than usual.
In addition, precipitation in the entire northern region was below average, ..
.. leading to a larger area of exposed ground surface, providing ample sources of sand and dust.
The second is that in 2023, movements of cold and warm air masses happened more frequently, ..
.. and windy weather in the northern region increased, which was conducive to transporting sand and dust.
Sand and dust storm weather causes air quality to decrease, ..
.. severely affecting people’s daily lives and also impacting the natural environment.
Once a sand and dust storm occurs, how should people protect themselves?
First, it’s important to replenish fluids by drinking more water, fruit juices, and soups to accelerate metabolism.
Second, it’s important to maintain humidity. Turn on the humidifier indoors to increase humidity.
Third, it’s important to take proper protective measures. When outside, make sure to wear a mask, goggles, and other dust protection gear.
After returning home, make sure to clean your face and nasal passages.
Finally, when driving, reduce your speed and park away from billboards, walls, etc.
Protecting against the sand treats the symptoms but not the root cause. Controlling the sand is the key.
Afforestation, protecting grasslands, ..
.. and tailoring solutions to local conditions by planting vegetation suitable for growth in desert areas, ..
.. in order to stabilize the soil, reduce wind speed, and so on, are all methods for controlling the sand.
Hopefully, in the future, sand and dust storm weather will be further and further away from us.
